paragraph: F ball and coin (the owner's paragraph)

sentences.1: Sally thew the ball hard at the walk.
sentences.2: So hard that the ball threw her backwards, bounced off the wall and smashed directly into her face.
sentences.3: It reminded her of the time she had a coin placed carefully in the palm of her hand.
sentences.4: When she closed her fist around the coin, turn her hand around, then opened her fist, the coin quickly slid out sideways before landing on the ground below her.

leftover: 'It reminded her of' (a likeness between two events has no form in the ledger)
the order of events in both halves
'hard', 'so hard', 'quickly', 'carefully', 'directly' (how much, and in what manner)
translator's readings: 'thew' as 'threw', 'walk' as 'wall', 'turn' as 'turned', 'turned her hand around' as 'palm facing down'
